name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.111.0 — token-cost trims for Fable 5.1 seats: core § Session Execution (edit-don't-rewrite, act on enough information, no extras, batch calls) served by every shared-for list; shared-for gains init (no more whole-doctrine fail-open) and run-design (the delta /spec:run's Design stage loads; build/review stages skip their own shared-for); shared-genesis/shared-mocks --section slice one supplement section and both drivers print the slice per step, so the 50 KB / 23 KB supplements are never read whole; shared-for stops echoing frontmatter; the plugin description's changelog paragraphs are one line each. Published as 7.111.0 after a concurrent session claimed 7.110.0. 7.110.1 — genesis doctrine's archetype hand-off paragraph corrected: DISCOVERY closes with `--mark discovery-done` and nothing else; BRIEF renders the hand-off one state later, branching on the registry row; drops a quoted literal genesis-driver.js has never printed. Doc-only. 7.110.0 — change-record format thinned: ADRs drop the backward 'Amended by:' header, the forward 'Applies to' section is the single amendment record and /spec:doctor audits that direction only; edit-in-place becomes the default for amending any brief, with a letter-suffixed successor minted only when the brief's premise changed; README points at docs/canonical/design.md.
